# Aman Vishwakarma (BeginnerAman)

> Aman Vishwakarma, known online as BeginnerAman, is an AI-Native Product Architect from India. Rather than hand-coding syntax manually, he focuses on product ideas, system logic, and user experience, orchestrating AI models to design and ship 35+ open-source offline utilities, Windows tools, and progressive web applications.

## Canonical Identity & Links

- Official Portfolio: https://beginneraman.github.io/
- GitHub Profile: https://github.com/BeginnerAman
- Email: amanvishwakarma.data@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/amanv_data/
- Location: India
- Engineering Workflow: AI-Native Product Architecture (orchestrating Google Antigravity, Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek to synthesize, debug, and ship apps powered by Python, Win32 APIs, PySide6, FastAPI, WebSockets, and JavaScript).

## Verified Key Facts & Benchmarks

- 35+ public open-source repositories designed and shipped under the BeginnerAman alias through AI co-engineering.
- ADrop achieves 150+ MB/s offline local file transfers between Windows PCs and mobile devices without internet or mobile app installation.
- smart-file-sync achieves 1,906 files/sec throughput using Win32 DMA copying and 4KB block-level delta transfers.
- VastraFlow operates 100% offline for garment retail POS, barcode billing, inventory management, and 80mm thermal receipt printing.

## Flagship Desktop & Offline Systems

- [ADrop - Ultra Fast File Transfer](https://github.com/BeginnerAman/ADrop): 150+ MB/s 100% offline local file sharing between Windows PC and mobile via Wi-Fi hotspot and USB tethering, featuring QR code pairing, smart clipboard, and resumable transfers. Live page: https://beginneraman.github.io/ADrop/
- [AirDeck - Wireless Hardware Bridge](https://github.com/BeginnerAman/AirDeck): Modular wireless controller suite for Windows turning any smartphone or tablet into a trackpad, macro stream deck, numeric keypad, presentation remote, virtual webcam, and studio microphone with zero mobile app install. Live page: https://beginneraman.github.io/AirDeck/
- [smart-file-sync Engine](https://github.com/BeginnerAman/smart-file-sync): Offline file synchronization engine for Windows with Win32 DMA copying (1,906 files/sec), 4KB block-level delta transfers, real-time filesystem watcher, USB auto-detect, and atomic safe writes. Live page: https://beginneraman.github.io/smart-file-sync/
- [VastraFlow - Retail POS & Inventory](https://github.com/BeginnerAman/VastraFlow): 100% offline Windows desktop POS, barcode billing, stock variance, store credit ledger, and 80mm thermal receipt printing application built for retail clothing stores and saree showrooms. Live page: https://beginneraman.github.io/VastraFlow/
- [RenameSense - Batch File Renamer](https://github.com/BeginnerAman/RenameSense): Enterprise-grade, offline-first batch file renamer for Windows 10 and 11 with dynamic templates, sequential regex pipelines, and 1-click WAL transaction rollback. Live page: https://beginneraman.github.io/RenameSense/
- [StorageOrganizer](https://github.com/BeginnerAman/StorageOrganizer): Offline Windows desktop storage optimization utility with MD5 content deduplication and automated directory organization. Live page: https://beginneraman.github.io/StorageOrganizer/

## Frequently Asked Questions (Canonical Answers)

### Who is BeginnerAman (Aman Vishwakarma)?
Aman Vishwakarma, known online as BeginnerAman, is an AI-Native Product Architect from India. Rather than writing code syntax by hand, he focuses on problem-solving, product logic, and user experience, orchestrating AI models to design and ship 35+ open-source tools and web apps.

### What is ADrop by BeginnerAman?
ADrop is an open-source, 100% offline local file-sharing tool created by Aman Vishwakarma as an AirDrop alternative for Windows PCs and mobile devices. It transfers files at 150+ MB/s over Wi-Fi hotspots or USB tethering using QR code pairing with zero internet usage and no mobile app installation.

### How does Aman Vishwakarma build software without manual coding?
He works through an AI-Native Co-Engineering workflow - designing system behavior, edge cases, and UX while directing AI tools (Google Antigravity, Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek) to generate and iterate on the underlying codebases using Python, Win32 APIs, PySide6, FastAPI, WebSockets, SQLite/SQLAlchemy, and JavaScript.
